articles.summary: The new crane is the largest in the Potain range of topless cranes, with a 40 t maximum capacity and the ability to lift 14.1 t at the end of its 80 m jib.German building materials and construction giant BACHL Group has received the first crane.Manitowoc Lift Solutions provided design and engineering support so the crane could be installed on an existing mast at the customer’s facility.
articles.title: Potain launches new heavyweight MDT 1609 and delivers first model to Germany

articles.summary: Manitowoc will bring three Grove cranes to JDL EXPO this September: the GMK5150XL, GMK4100L-2 and the GMK3060L-1.Alongside these models, Grove will also highlight the latest advances in its growing customer support operation.Potain will present its latest customer support products and will highlight its experience in constructing nuclear plants.
articles.title: Three Grove cranes and expanded customer support offering headline Manitowoc's JDL EXPO 2026 presence

articles.summary: The Grove GMK5150XLe Plug-in Hybrid all-terrain was shown in the colors of its first UK customer, Bryn Thomas Cranes.Customer support displays highlighted Manitowoc’s aftermarket and lifecycle support, while the booth was shared with MGX Equipment Services, which launched in the UK earlier this year.
articles.title: Manitowoc showcases hybrid innovation, crane versatility and enhanced customer support at Vertikal Days 2026
